Assets.NotesMarkdown: A shorter menu: wallets sit under Clients, payment methods under Settings, notifications behind the bell and security in the user menu. New Plugins screen for Reverse, Smart dealer and Slippage. Statuses are filled badges in one colour per meaning. System groups cannot be deleted, and a group that still has accounts cannot be deleted either. The New account form has a country search, a phone field with the dialling code, and fixed width. Pop-ups no longer close on an outside click. The top bar has a search field and the broker chip, and the bottom strip shows broker, role and the UTC time.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Every table now shows its data in full contrast; only empty placeholders stay dim. Closed trades shows commission and swap with two decimals, from the broker's side: commission and the swap clients pay are positive, swap paid to a client is negative.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: The dealer queue alert chimes once when a new order arrives and reminds you every 30 seconds while orders wait, from any screen; it stops the moment the queue is empty, and you can switch it off in Settings, Sounds. Sign in inside the main window, with a Live or Demo stream choice; session expired and switch account appear in the window too. Every password field has a show/hide eye and a Caps Lock warning. Notifications is back in the menu, and one event is one row: a margin call shows its updates, a stop-out lists its tickets. Dealing shows full labels at every size, the Hedge table has its header, and Dealer P/L is one number. The Server cell says Connected, Reconnecting or Disconnected. Clients, All now includes closed and suspended accounts.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: The Dashboard has a Live / Demo / All switch: client counts and lists follow it, money figures stay live-only unless you choose All, and New clients shows the live and demo split. Long status messages no longer cover the function keys at the bottom of the window.
Assets.NotesHTML: The Dashboard has a Live / Demo / All switch: client counts and lists follow it, money figures stay live-only unless you choose All, and New clients shows the live and demo split. Long status messages no longer cover the function keys at the bottom of the window.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Results of actions on several positions or orders are one short line, for example Break-even: 3 set · 18 skipped, with the reasons under why?. Messages disappear by themselves after a few seconds (hover to keep one, × to close it); the full history stays in the log. Before you sign in, the window shows the empty app behind the sign-in card, with no sample data.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Lists answer the first click: one click selects a row and shows its preview, a second click or a double-click opens it. Opening a client is smooth, with a clear Back to clients button (Esc also works). Row menus have clear labels. A list filtered to one account shows a chip you can clear.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Sign-in no longer asks you to choose a Live or Demo stream: you always sign in to your broker's backoffice, and Live / Demo / All is chosen on the Dashboard.
Assets.NotesHTML: Sign-in no longer asks you to choose a Live or Demo stream: you always sign in to your broker's backoffice, and Live / Demo / All is chosen on the Dashboard.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Sign-in always starts at the sign-in card; with Remember me your e-mail is filled in, so you just click Sign In. Live data loads only after you sign in. The sign-in card shows only the broker's name; the version is in Settings, About.
Assets.NotesHTML: Sign-in always starts at the sign-in card; with Remember me your e-mail is filled in, so you just click Sign In. Live data loads only after you sign in. The sign-in card shows only the broker's name; the version is in Settings, About.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Security shows your broker's two-step sign-in policy. Where it is optional, you can turn two-step sign-in off or set it up yourself; where it is required, nothing changes.
Assets.NotesHTML: Security shows your broker's two-step sign-in policy. Where it is optional, you can turn two-step sign-in off or set it up yourself; where it is required, nothing changes.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Groups: the group menu now has Add account…, which opens the New account form with that group already chosen.
Assets.NotesHTML: Groups: the group menu now has Add account…, which opens the New account form with that group already chosen.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Groups: a group can now have its own volume step. The Add and Edit group form has a new Volume step (lots) field next to the minimum and maximum volume: allowed volumes go from the minimum in whole steps (for example 0.05, 0.10, 0.15), and a blank step keeps each symbol's own step. The form checks the number as you save, and if the step does not fit a symbol's own volume step the reason is shown in the form. The step also appears in the group's details and in Save as CSV.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Clients: the client page has a clearer way back. The Back to clients button is now a filled button with an orange outline that turns solid orange when you point at it, and it can be reached and pressed with the keyboard. The header above the client's details now reads Clients > account number, where Clients takes you back to the list, instead of the repeated CLIENT label.

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
Backoffice 1.0.84: the Reason column of the client ledger, the Open transaction details, Copy row and the account statement CSV no longer show "(automatic)" for closes by stop loss, take profit or stop-out. They read "Stop loss hit", "Take profit hit" and "Stop-out: margin level X% at or below Y%". Demo closes still say "(demo)". Only what is shown changes; the stored text is untouched.
 Updates now install only when you choose: click "Update available" and confirm to restart into the new version, or close the app and it installs as it closes; it never restarts or closes by itself.
Assets.NotesHTML: Backoffice 1.0.84: the Reason column of the client ledger, the Open transaction details, Copy row and the account statement CSV no longer show "(automatic)" for closes by stop loss, take profit or stop-out. They read "Stop loss hit", "Take profit hit" and "Stop-out: margin level X% at or below Y%". Demo closes still say "(demo)". Only what is shown changes; the stored text is untouched. Updates now install only when you choose: click "Update available" and confirm to restart into the new version, or close the app and it installs as it closes; it never restarts or closes by itself.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.85: the Columns menu (and the Dealing market watch columns menu) no longer shifts its labels when you tick or untick a column. Settings now has a Check for updates button under the version and build: it says whether you are on the latest version, offers Update now when there is one, and never installs anything on its own. The account statement can now be saved as an HTML page (broker logo, print and PDF friendly) or an Excel workbook (one sheet each for open positions, closed deals, ledger and summary) as well as CSV; the HTML and Excel versions show commission and swap as the client sees them. Signing in again or resuming a saved session now always uses one session.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.86: Closed trades (DLS) has a POSITIONS | DEALS switch. DEALS lists every execution, one row each: the opening, every partial and final close, both legs of a close-by and the two legs of a reverse, with the deal number, time, position, direction, reason in plain words, lots, price, commission and swap as the broker sees them, and profit. It uses the same date range, search and account filter as the closed trades list; double-click a deal to open its client.
